implemented_locally: Canonical usage events are attributable to tenant, organisation, project, environment, optional Agent version, Mission and Action.
Usage event identity is idempotent and conflicting event reuse is rejected.
Estimated cost is separated from settled and unsettled non-estimated cost.
Settlement identity is deterministic and a usage event cannot be settled twice under different settlement identities.
Settlement provider, currency and amount must reconcile exactly to the recorded usage event.
Local ledger state is protected by atomic writes and a private operation lock.
Summaries group by usage kind, unit and currency; mixed dimensions do not produce a combined scalar total.

verification.full_command: cd packages/atlas && npm run metadata:write && npm run metadata:check && npm test -- --testTimeout=30000 && npm run build && git diff --check

limitations: This is local filesystem proof only; no CI, staging or hosted ledger proof exists.
No provider/model invoice fixture, payment processor settlement, pricing service or commercial billing integration was exercised.
No database transaction, queue worker or cross-process exactly-once accounting proof exists.
The ledger is exported as a public package API but is not yet wired into the Mission inspect projection; that acceptance gap remains visible in P1-006 evidence.
Absent proof remains: CI, staging, provider/model invoice reconciliation, billing settlement, production, commercial readiness, whole-product certification.
Original narrative record did not capture execution timestamps; canonical timestamps are recorded as not-recorded.
